East Shewa Fertilizer Advisory — Methods Note

This note documents how woreda-level N-rate recommendations were derived for teff, sorghum, and maize in East Shewa zone, Ethiopia.

Data sources

EthioSIS soil rasters, AEZ boundaries, and DST field trial data were combined using zonal statistics.
